email.subject: Clearwater Pros: a couple quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I looked at Clearwater Pros Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: it's not mobile-friendly, so anyone searching for a plumber on their phone (most people, in an emergency) has a hard time using it. And there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors have to copy your number instead of just tapping to call.

Your site also doesn't list business hours, which adds friction for people deciding whether to call now.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I mean, no pitch attached.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
